Ascend NPU MFU notes

Model FLOPs utilisation (MFU) is the ratio of achieved to peak FLOPs.

See the MFU appendix for the formula, and the NPU guide for hardware details.

Checklist

  • measure tokens per second
  • count model FLOPs per token
mfu = achieved_flops / peak_flops
